SELECT loan_contracts.account_id, loan_contracts.branch_id, loan_contracts.created_at, loan_contracts.currency, loan_contracts.customer_id, loan_contracts.days_past_due, loan_contracts.disbursement_date, loan_contracts.installment_amount, loan_contracts.interest_rate, loan_contracts.loan_id, loan_contracts.loan_product_id, loan_contracts.loan_type, loan_contracts.maturity_date, loan_contracts.outstanding_balance, loan_contracts.principal_amount, loan_contracts.status, loan_contracts.term_months, loan_contracts.updated_at
FROM customers
LEFT JOIN loan_contracts ON customers.customer_id = loan_contracts.customer_id
LIMIT 100
